card.name: Comma after "clinical worsening" in antidepressant warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after "clinical worsening" in the antidepressant boxed warning about monitoring patients. The next words are about suicidality or suicidal thoughts and behaviors.

modes.label: Monitoring for worsening, then suicidality
modes.description: Comma after "monitor all ... patients for clinical worsening" that introduces suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
modes.example: Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening<<,>> and for emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors

modes.label: Close observation for worsening, then suicidality
modes.description: Comma after "observed closely for clinical worsening" followed by suicidality.
modes.example: should be monitored appropriately and observed closely for clinical worsening<<,>> suicidality, or unusual changes in

card.writes: It pushes down death and killing words such as fatal, killed and deaths, so the list continues with suicidality wording instead.
card.plain: It responds to the comma in the antidepressant warning where the text moves from worsening to suicidal thoughts.
